name: Highlighter
description: A translucent highlighter stroke that sweeps across its own clip box: put the clip exactly over a word, a line or a number (in a picture, an evidence clip, a text clip) on a track above it. Draws no text.

at.description: Time the sweep starts: "line:7+0.2" or seconds from the clip start. Default: the clip start

shape.description: block fills the box; underline is its bottom third; marker is a pen stroke with uneven edges

color.description: theme token (gold, accent, good, bad) or CSS

ground.description: light multiplies like ink; dark screens so it stays visible. For a true ink look also set the clip's blend to multiply
